data.value:
BK POLYOMA QUALITATIVE PCR

Test Principle Real Time PCR
Specimen BLOOD 


Result: 

BK POLYOMA virus Qualitative NOT DETECTED


Result Interpretation :

  • A "Not Detected" result indicates that BK Polyma Virus is Absent in the individual
  • A "Detected" result indicates that BK Polyma Virus is Present in the individual


Clinical Background:

  • In renal transplant patients severe renal allograft dysfunction is seen due to reactivation of B K polyoma virus secondary to immunosuppressant medications.It is also associated with ureteral stenosis and interstitial nephritis.
  • In bone marrow transplant recipients it is a cause for hemorrhagic cystitis.
  • The presence of BK polyoma in the bladder is linked to the development of bladder carcinoma.
  • PCR is a specific and sensitive test for the detection of B K polyoma virus in patients of renal allograft with viral nephropathy.


Limitation of Assay:

Presence of PCR inhibitors in the sample may prevent DNA amplification.Paradoxical results may arise due selection of inappropriate specimens and contamination during specimen collection.

Note: The test was developed in-house and its performance characteristics determined at Metropolis Healthcare
Ltd.

Reference :
